what_this_is: The fresh registered run's OWN preregistration with its OWN frozen digests, per DESIGN-voice-completion §5. It is not an amendment of v0.19's prereg and it does not re-score v0.19's run.
v0.19's numbers are not restated. experiments/foreign_voice_rate.json stays committed as it read, VOID and all, and its `prereg_revalidated` block preserves the 22 digests as that run measured them.
The fresh run's rate is a DIFFERENT NUMBER OVER A DIFFERENT GRAMMAR and every quotation of it says so.

b0d_seed_is_derived.rule: seed = sha256_lf( git show {parent}:data/foreign_voice/lexicon.json ), {parent} = the amendment commit's parent
b0d_seed_is_derived.why: B0d's pool is the ELIGIBLE set and is grammar-independent, so the seed still identifies its draw — but the lexicon moved, so the value is a consequence to be recomputed rather than a constant to be read off the tree. The derivation is in the sealed file's own header.

c_v4_prime.it_is_a_new_preregistration: not a re-score of v0.19's run, and not a re-reading of its artifact
the_c_r2_clause_restored: Construct each mutation, ELABORATE THE MUTATED TERM FIRST, discard any mutation whose term did not change, COUNT THE DISCARDS, and only then score the survivors.

That is the clause C-V4 inherited the idea from and left behind. A mutation that does not change the term is not a near miss the gate failed to catch — it is not a near miss at all, and scoring it as one is how a control talks itself into a bad number as readily as a good one.
c_v4_prime.id_source: data/foreign_voice/cv4_replay_ids.json — the drawn ids, not a seed
c_v4_prime.deletion_is_by_matched_pair: by index, from the parse the rule already computed. v0.19 deleted the first opening and the first closing independently; those coincide only when the first bracket contains no nested bracket, and 3 of its sampled 50 nest.

drop_ascription.note: unchanged by this design; read exactly 0.90 in v0.19

drop_group.note: RAISED from 0.90. The population of redundant pairs is empty by construction, and a mutation that cannot be a no-op should not carry a 10% allowance for being one. Demoted to a confirmation by G1b.

drop_binder.note: blind by construction; measured, never scored. Canonical grouping does nothing for this class and is not claimed to.

c_v4_prime.margin_to_floor: published per class, signed, always — so the margin is READ rather than inferred

the_point_prediction.why: its pool (2,285) does not move with the grammar and its drawn 50 are unchanged
the_point_prediction.measured_correction_to_the_movers_named_: ZERO of the 16 binder-group statements fall in drop_ascription's drawn 50 (or in drop_group's), so binder-group stripping cannot move it; the only candidate movers are the 6 of its 50 whose grouping changes, and oracle nondeterminism
the_point_prediction.the_direction_is_pre_registered_too: a C-R2-clause discard in any of the five classes means that class clears with REAL MARGIN rather than by luck, and that is the finding

the_class_most_likely_to_void_named_now.why: it read EXACTLY 0.90 against a 0.90 floor in v0.19 and this design does nothing for it. Its floor is neither raised nor lowered. If it voids, it voids on a boundary that was visible before the run.

c_v4_prime.voiding_sentence: any class in the voiding pool below its floor voids the C-V4′ reading and, through it, the sentence B1 is allowed to make

c_g1.both_must_clear: if any of the ten is still blind, C-G1 voids REGARDLESS of the aggregate

pending.why: C-V3′'s pinned local reader. Its weights-digest refusal is a CONSTRUCTION PREREQUISITE (Correction 9): weights_blob_sha256 appears exactly once in the whole tree and nothing reads it at run time, so this control must BUILD the model-side refusal, not inherit it.

The pilot that must establish reproducibility BEFORE any floor is frozen. There is no seed field in any manifest or request body in the tree, so temperature-0 determinism is an assumption this repository has never tested. If reproducibility fails, C-V3′ publishes that failure as its result and reverts to ABSENT.
The fresh run. Frozen when it lands, and it refuses to publish unless every digest here revalidates.

c_v3_human_still_absent.reason: no determinacy sheet, no non-maintainer marking
c_v3_human_still_absent.consequence: NO CLAIM that a PERSON can recover the mathematics determinately from the English, here or in the release
c_v3_human_still_absent.c_v3_prime_does_not_substitute: a machine reader measures whether the sentence determines the term TO THAT MACHINE, which is a fact about a model and not about a reader. Saying so is load-bearing precisely because a measured machine number is the most tempting thing in this design to over-read.
